title: Deck studio — unified workspace (Gentle / Flat)
brief: One workspace for the whole flow: the outline from 01 always on the left (rows gain thumbnail and status), the selected slide in the center with View / Comment / Edit, comments and agent replies on the right. Gentle brand by default, Flat switch in every screen.

artboards.title: Workspace · armando la estructura
artboards.tradeoff: Before generating: outline editable on the left, look & feel previews in the center, slide comments on the right. Everything on one screen, so the center is narrower than a dedicated plan page

artboards.title: Workspace · generando y editando
artboards.tradeoff: During/after generation: the same outline now shows live thumbnails and status; the center edits the selected slide (inline edit, pinned comments, overflow); the agent answers in the comment thread. Dense, but nothing is lost when switching tasks

artboards.title: Earlier · Shell native plan
artboards.tradeoff: Previous direction kept for reference: the outline style the user liked

artboards.title: Earlier · Workbench editor
artboards.tradeoff: Previous direction kept for reference: editor and grid ideas folded into 05
